Kerosene can be produced through [[cracking|Catalytic Cracking Tower]] or [[irradiating|Radiolysis Chamber]] [[diesel variants|Diesel]], or [[fractioning|Fractioning Tower]] [[light oil variants|Light Oil]]. Kerosene is used for a variety of functions including [[balefire plasma|Balefire Plasma]], as a solvent for fuels in the [[purex|Purex]], or for refueling most jetpacks.
